metadata.notes: Zero-score root cause: model-side Codex run interruption caused an incomplete C++ submission, followed by build failure. The transcript ends with an API/policy error (`Invalid prompt: your prompt was flagged as potentially violating our usage policy`) and `turn.failed`, while the agent was still reasoning about recurrence/week-number implementation and never produced a final message. The run wrote a partial implementation (11 files, 1934 LOC) but left CMakeLists.txt referencing missing sources (`main.cpp`, `rrule.cpp`, and `timezone.cpp`). A direct CMake configure check fails with `Cannot find source file: main.cpp` and `No SOURCES given to target: ical`, which explains why all 465 tests errored before exercising behavior. This is not no_code_written or local infrastructure failure; it is a model/agent-side interrupted incomplete submission whose published score should remain zero unless policy-error runs are excluded by the study rules.

editorial.last_message: No final message; model-side policy rejection interrupted work before the C++ submission was complete, leaving a build-failing project.
